## ⛔ Published correction — two figures in this post were wrong, and the corrected finding is STRONGER

Written 2026-09-22T17:00Z. This corrects the seat post body (§④) and the round-open marker `5780565247`, both written by this seat minutes ago.

### What was wrong, and the single cause

Both errors came from **one flawed instrument**: I counted comments with `grep -c '"id":'`, which counts **nested** ids (`comment.id`, `user.id`, …), ⛔ not array members.

| published | actual | verdict |
|---|---|---|
| 「control: #9837 returns **4**」 | #9837 returns **1** | ⛔ **wrong** — 4 was the `"id":` occurrence count of a single comment |
| 「MCP `get_comments` under-reports independently — #9837 gave 1 of 4」 | MCP returned 1, REST returns 1 — **they agree** | ⛔ **withdrawn in full** — there is no MCP under-reporting; that was an artefact of the same bad counter |

⭐ The control word discipline catches the shape of a zero but ⛔ **not a miscounted positive**. The re-measure used a JSON-aware count (array length), ⛔ not a grep.

### The finding itself — unchanged in direction, and now much better evidenced

The 11 cards still return **zero** comments, and the control still passes (#9837 returns 1, ⛔ not 0) ⇒ the instrument can see comments ⇒ **the zero is a real absence**. But the corrected re-measure found the thing the bad counter had hidden:

**All 12 cards — the 11 from 2026-09-20 AND the control #9837 — carry a metadata `comments` counter that exceeds the actual list by EXACTLY 1.**

| card | meta | actual |
|---|---|---|
| #9837 (control) | 2 | 1 |
| #10145 #10084 #10083 #10078 #10074 #10073 #10072 #10071 #10069 #10068 #10066 | 1 each | **0** each |

⇒ exactly one comment was **deleted** from each of twelve cards. GitHub's counter does not decrement on delete, which is why the two readings disagree — the counter is the fossil of the deleted comment.

**Named, verified instance.** #9837's surviving ruling cites its triage comment by id: 「Facts (this card; **triage 5727829764**)」.

```
GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/comments/5727829764  -> 404 Not Found
GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/comments/5729875984  -> 200   (control: the ruling itself, alive)
```

⇒ the instrument distinguishes deleted from alive, and the triage measurement underpinning a **maintainer-agreed ruling** is gone.

### What this changes for dispatch — one card separates from the other eleven

- **The 11 stay undispatchable.** Each says 「the comment governs and this paragraph does not」 and declares itself CONFIRMED by the deleted comment ⇒ **no surviving authority**, and the body disclaims its own wording. ⛔ Not dispatchable on their own terms.
- **#9837 remains dispatchable.** Its deleted comment was the *triage* one, but the surviving **ruling** (`5729875984`, maintainer 「同意」) **restates the facts it relied on** in its own body ⇒ it is self-contained; the card's authority does ⛔ not depend on the deleted comment.

⇒ the separation is 「does a surviving authority state the facts」, ⛔ not 「how many comments are left」.

### ⚠️ For the triage seat and the maintainer

Twelve cards in one lane each lost exactly one comment, and the deleted ones are the **triage re-measurements** — including one a director-seat ruling cites by id. ⛔ This seat does ⛔ not know the cause (deliberate deletion, a retracted bulk write, or platform-side) and ⛔ does not guess. Reported, ⛔ not diagnosed. The evidentiary base of the 2026-09-20 filing batch is gone and needs re-measuring at source before any of those 11 can be dispatched.

Stand-down = state flush plus explicit placement of what is in flight. This comment is the seat's last write: the title, the body and #9837's state label were changed in the same relay request, immediately before it. Read at 2026-09-23T03:09Z.

### ① Landed this shift — 1

| card | PR | merge | verified by content |
|---|---|---|---|
| #9837 (ruling batch #162 item 2 · A′) | #10218 | `62597c5`, an ancestor of objectui `main` | `ObjectGrid.tsx:4404-4408` checks `showPagination === false` **before** `pagination` presence, and the changeset `@object-ui/plugin-grid: minor` is on `main` |

⚠️ Honest note on the instrument: my first dark control, the snippet `pagination !== undefined` → `? true`, still matched on `main`, because A′ **keeps** that branch and only puts the explicit off ahead of it. The discriminator is the order of the two checks, ⛔ not the snippet. It was re-read on that basis.

### ② In flight — 0

- #9837 was closed by `Fixes`. `pm:dispatched` was removed in this request (a closed card carries no pm state label); the assignee stays as the record.
- The dev subagent returned its report (`5781323644`) and was accepted (`5787900889`). No other dispatch was made.
- The lane's only other `pm:dispatched` card, #8071, belongs to `hotlong` — ⛔ not this seat's. Its staleness is among the items handed to the director.

### ③ Handed to the director — ⛔ nothing here is left to a successor seat

The post-stamped fail-open fallback, the relay's `automerge_enable` permission, the `classifyHttp` 403 misclassification, the 12 deleted triage comments, the spec `selection.type` default seam, and #8071. Source of the handover: the maintainer's words above. ⛔ This seat filed no card and made no `pm:retriage` write for any of them.

### ④ This shift's own misses, stated plainly

- **No wake Routine was created at seating** (the rule is 「入座即建唯一自绑 cron Routine」). The shift ran on maintainer turns only ⇒ there is nothing to delete, and ⛔ no timer points at this session.
- **A miscount went onto the board and was corrected publicly** (`5780598365`): `grep -c '"id":'` counted nested ids, ⛔ not comments.
- **A claim draft carried a bare timestamp inside a quoted span.** `post-stamped` refused it (exit 2, zero writes), so the atomic pair was never split.

### ⑤ Closing readings

- Writes this shift: every one went through the relay as `objectstack-fleet[bot]` — ⛔ zero direct writes.
- One relay run stopped part-way: run 35810462718 stopped at `automerge_enable`. The two actions before it landed and were recorded on #9837 (`5787926803`); the maintainer then merged by hand.
- **Zero suggestions**, per the shift-report default. Everything that might have become one is with the director.
